You are Quarterback's stress-tester for UC San Diego degree plans. Deterministic code has already verified every plan below (prerequisites, units, requirements, offerings). Your job is cross-quarter feasibility under uncertainty: which plan the student should trust, and which must be refused.

Evidence: the table lists, for each planned course and quarter, a status with an evidence id (ev_<CODE>_<QUARTER>), the source and the verbatim quote. Statuses: "offered" or "tentative" — a department page or the Schedule of Classes lists the course; "not_offered" — the department page has no instructor for that quarter; "unknown (not on dept page)" — the department's page covers that quarter and has no row for the course at all; plain "unknown" — nobody publishes anything for that quarter (beyond the page's published year, or a department with no page; the quote says what was consulted).

REFUSE a plan — list it in refused with at least one evidence id — when BOTH hold:
1. It places a course in a quarter whose evidence status is "not_offered" or "unknown (not on dept page)".
2. That course is load-bearing: a later course in the same plan needs it as a prerequisite, or it is why the plan graduates earlier than another plan, or moving it to its next evidenced quarter would push the plan's graduation quarter.
Cite evidence by id only. Never write a quote yourself; the student sees the stored quote, url and fetch time for each id you cite. Write each refusal's reason for that plan specifically.

Do NOT refuse for: plain "unknown" in a quarter beyond the published page or in a department with no page (a risk: name the course and quarter to re-check); a course whose status is offered on a page that calls itself tentative (a risk); unit loads within the cap; anything the next Schedule of Classes will settle (a risk).

Recommend exactly one plan that is not refused: the one whose placements have the most evidence; when tied, the balanced plan. Recommend null only when every plan is refused. Every plan that is neither recommended nor refused needs at least one risk line naming what to re-check. The summary is two or three plain sentences for the student.

Be decisive: check each plan against the two refusal conditions, decide, and call submit_verdict. Do not re-derive the evidence table.

summary.description: Two or three sentences for the student

message.reasoning_content:
Let me analyze each plan against the refusal conditions. I need to check for courses placed in quarters with "not_offered" or "unknown (not on dept page)" status that are load-bearing.

First, let me understand the evidence statuses:
- "offered" - department page or Schedule of Classes lists the course
- "tentative" - department page calls itself tentative but lists the course
- "not_offered" - department page has no instructor for that quarter
- "unknown (not on dept page)" - department's page covers that quarter and has no row for the course at all
- "unknown" - nobody publishes anything for that quarter (beyond published page, or department with no page)

Refusal conditions (BOTH must hold):
1. Course placed in quarter with evidence status "not_offered" or "unknown (not on dept page)"
2. That course is load-bearing: later course needs it as prereq, OR it's why plan graduates earlier than another, OR moving it would push graduation quarter

Let me check each plan:

### p-fastest-2 (graduation FA27)
Courses and their evidence:
- WI27: COGS 109 (offered - ev_COGS109_WI27), COGS 112 (offered - ev_COGS112_WI27), COGS 115 (offered - ev_COGS115_WI27), COGS 160 (offered - ev_COGS160_WI27), COGS 163 (offered - ev_COGS163_WI27)
- SP27: COGS 107C (offered - ev_COGS107C_SP27), COGS 151 (offered - ev_COGS151_SP27), CSE 6R (offered - ev_CSE6R_SP27), AAS 10 (unknown - ev_AAS10_SP27), ANTH 10 (unknown - ev_ANTH10_SP27)
- FA27: COGS 101C (unknown - ev_COGS101C_FA27), COGS 171 (unknown - ev_COGS171_FA27), COGS 177 (unknown - ev_COGS177_FA27), AAS 11 (unknown - ev_AAS11_FA27), PHYS 10 (unknown - ev_PHYS10_FA27)

Wait, I need to check the evidence more carefully. Let me look at each:

COGS 101C FA27: ev_COGS101C_FA27 says "unknown" from cape-history. But there's also ev_COGS101C_SP27 which says "not_offered" for SP27, and ev_COGS101C_WI27 says "offered" for WI27. So COGS 101C is offered in WI27 but not in SP27, and unknown for FA27.

COGS 177 FA27: ev_COGS177_FA27 says "unknown" from cape-history. ev_COGS177_SP27 says "not_offered" for SP27. ev_COGS177_WI27 says "offered" for WI27.

AAS 10 SP27: ev_AAS10_SP27 says "unknown" (cape-history)

AAS 11 FA27: ev_AAS11_FA27 says "unknown" (cape-history)

Now, which of these are "not_offered" or "unknown (not on dept page)"? The evidence shows:
- "unknown" from cape-history - this is plain "unknown" (beyond published page or department with no page) - NOT a refusal condition
- "not_offered" from department-page - this IS a refusal condition
- "unknown" from department-page or cape-history with "no department page row" - this IS "unknown (not on dept page)"

Let me re-read the evidence descriptions:
- ev_COGS101C_SP27: "not_offered" from department-page - YES, fetched 2026-09-28
- ev_COGS163_SP27: "not_offered" from department-page fetched 2026-09-28
- ev_CSE6R_WI27: "not_offered" from department-page fetched 2026-09-28
- ev_COGS177_SP27: "not_offered" from department-page fetched 2026-09-28
- ev_COGS151_WI27: "not_offered" from department-page fetched 2026-09-28

And "unknown (not on dept page)" would be like:
- ev_ETHN1R_SP27: "unknown" from cape-history, "no source found — no department page row, no SP27 section, no CAPE history" - this is plain "unknown" (no department page)
- ev_GLBH120_FA27: "unknown" from cape-history, "no source found — no department page row, no FA27 section, no CAPE history" - plain "unknown"
- ev_AAS10_SP27: "unknown" from cape-history, "last CAPE-evaluated offering SP23; 11 quarters on record" - this is plain "unknown" (cape-history)

Wait, the evidence says "unknown | cape-history" for AAS 10. The status definitions:
- "unknown (not on dept page)" — the department's page covers that quarter and has no row for the course at all
- plain "unknown" — nobody publishes anything for that quarter (beyond the page's published year, or a department with no page)

For AAS, there's no department page mentioned. The evidence says "cape-history". So AAS likely has no department page, making it plain "unknown".

For COGS 101C FA27: ev_COGS101C_FA27 says "unknown | cape-history". But COGS has a department page that publishes FA26, WI27, SP27. So FA27 is beyond the published page (page publishes up to SP27). So this is plain "unknown".

For COGS 171 FA27: ev_COGS171_FA27 says "unknown | cape-history". FA27 is beyond SP27, so plain "unknown".
